items.claim: [r53-1] Hovering a separator left a pending submenu open running
items.note: (no longer applies). Commit 7977b94841 now treats a hover over a separator as a hover over no row, so it cancels the pending open the same way padding does. The test in `packages/menu/src/controller.test.ts:186` covers it.

items.claim: [r53-2] A letter typed mid-search was taken as an access letter or a number-row step
items.note: (no longer applies). Since commit 6a59fd6ce8, `planKey` adds any single character typed mid-search to the search first, as long as the search still finds a row. The tests in `packages/menu/src/keyPlan.test.ts:40` and `:52` cover it.

items.claim: A letter typed mid-search that is another row's access letter chooses that row instead of continuing the search
`+`, `=` and `-` typed mid-search step a highlighted number row instead of extending the search
`spin` reports a key as handled when it writes nothing (disabled row, closed menu)
Every window resize closes the menu, including the soft keyboard that editing a text or number row opens
Pointer-driven level changes keep the typeahead buffer, so the next key searches the new level with the old level's text
Opening a different submenu at the same level keeps the previous child's panel rect for the diagonal allowance
